text:
sarah: Quick share — brought up Marlin-70B on our regional fleets and ran a quantization profile sweep across FP16/BF16/INT8/FP8. High level notes + numbers below, flagging kernel/regional differences.

kevin: awesome, did you do H100 and A100 in all regions?

sarah: yes: us-east-1 (H100), eu-west-1 (A100), ap-southeast-1 (H100v2). Used the inference harness v2.3 with the same 512-token eval set and a 1000-sample prompt suite.

maya: TL;DR numbers?

sarah: short table (throughput = tokens/sec, quality = avg BLEU-like score on our eval set, delta = relative to FP16):

```
GPU / Region   | FP16 (baseline) | INT8 speedup | INT8 quality Δ | FP8 speedup | FP8 quality Δ
---------------------------------------------------------------
H100 / us-east  |  4200 tps       |  2.6x        |  -0.9%         |  3.1x       |  -0.4%
A100 / eu-west  |  3100 tps       |  1.8x        |  -1.8%         |  2.0x       |  -0.9%
H100v2 / apac   |  3900 tps       |  2.3x        |  -1.2%         |  2.8x       |  -0.6%
```

sarah: Notes: INT8 gives larger speedups on H100 due to the new cutlass kernel + persistent KV caching patch. A100 needs an alternate kernel path (triton fallback) which reduces speedup. FP8 is promising: small quality loss and best speedup on H100 but requires special kernel and careful memory alignment.

dave: can you paste the exact command you ran?

sarah: sure — benchmark harness run (condensed):

```
./bench_harness --model marlin-70b --profile {fp16,int8,fp8} --region {us-east-1,eu-west-1,ap-southeast-1} \
  --warmup 200 --samples 1000 --seq-len 512 --batch 8 --kernels auto --kv-cache on --out s3://redwood-bench/marlin70b/
```

kevin: how about capacity sizing? what pool size for predictable 95th pct latency under 150ms?

sarah: rough guidance from the run: use H100: provision ~12 GPUs per 1k RPS for FP16 baseline. For INT8 on H100, you can provision ~5 GPUs per 1k RPS (2.4x reduction). For FP8 on H100, ~4 GPUs per 1k RPS but margin is smaller; recommend +20% buffer for fragmentation. A100: INT8 gives ~1.6-1.8x savings.

maya: any regression alerts triggered?

sarah: INT8 on eu-west triggered a small regression alert in the eval harness (avg -1.8%). We ran hallucination and factuality checks — biggest drift on long-context summaries. Recommendation: hold INT8 in eu-west for now for customer-facing endpoints, or enable quality gating to fall back to FP16 on a per-request scorer.

infra-bot: deploy-log: kernel-cutlass-2.1 applied to us-east-1 cluster at 2023-11-02T14:22:11Z

eva: kernel ops question — are we using fused flash-attn for FP8?

sarah: yes on H100 we enable fused flash-attn + custom quant-dequant fusion. On A100 we fall back to a slower triton kernel because fused kernels are unstable on our current driver. That's the main perf gap.

kevin: any stability issues in longer runs / memory fragmentation?

sarah: FP8 saw higher memory fragmentation on long-running pools in apac (OOMs on a few nodes) — tracked to allocator behavior with the custom kernel. We mitigated by tuning CUDA_MALLOC_ASYNC and bumping the JVM-like arena size in the runtime. Follow-up: infra to run a soak for 48h on apac H100v2 with FP8 kernels.

maya: next steps?

sarah: 1) run a targeted INT8 run with the new A100-specific kernel (kevin to schedule) 2) 48h soak for FP8 in apac (infra) 3) add per-route quality gate to fall back to FP16 when eval score < threshold (eva + ml-evals) 4) rerun the latency/throughput sweeps with larger seq lens (2k) next week.

kevin: i'll schedule the A100 kernel run and post results here. can we add a small perf dashboard (per-region) on console?

sarah: yes — I'll open a console ticket and attach the CSVs. s3 path: s3://redwood-bench/marlin70b/1850012345/

maya: thanks — super useful. tagging for visibility: @eva @kevin @dave :thumbsup:

sarah: FYI for anyone reading later — INT8 = best cost wins on H100 but watch quality in eu. FP8 = best overall perf but operationally riskier until soak/allocator fixes.
